item.title: Epstein files row derails House session: Speaker Mike Johnson announces early end; Maxwell subpoena, records battle loom
item.description: Amidst uproar over the Jeffrey Epstein investigation, House Speaker Mike Johnson abruptly ended the legislative session early, blaming Democrats for derailing proceedings. Republicans suspended legislative activity, prompting criticism from within their own party, particularly from Representative Thomas Massie.

item.title: Staying in Dubai this summer? Here are 11 must-visit cool indoor venues for sports and entertainment
item.description: Dubai’s new indoor activity guide, launched under the #DubaiDestinations summer campaign, highlights top air-conditioned venues for sports, family fun, and edutainment. From skiing and football to rainforest adventures and creative play zones, the guide reflects Dubai’s vision to become the world’s most liveable city, offering safe, enriching, and memorable experiences for all ages, even in peak summer.

item.title: Ozzy Osbourne dies at 76: Black Sabbath legend was battling Parkinson’s; mourned by fans worldwide
item.description: Ozzy Osbourne, the iconic frontman of Black Sabbath and a heavy metal legend, has passed away at the age of 76, weeks after performing his farewell show. Known for his dark stage presence and influential role in shaping heavy metal music, Osbourne battled health issues, including Parkinson's disease, in recent years.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE-based Indian doctor from Kerala found dead at her Abu Dhabi residence
item.description: Beyond her professional achievements as a dental surgeon, Dr. Dhanalakshmi was a gifted writer and a compelling orator, admired for her versatility. She played an active and vibrant role in the Indian expatriate community in Abu Dhabi, particularly within the Malayalee circle. As a respected cultural activist and member of the Abu Dhabi Malayalee Samajam, she made significant contributions to preserving and promoting her heritage. ​She often volunteered her time for community awareness sessions, using her voice to promote health, well-being, and harmony.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Trump vs Powell: Scott Bessent softens tone; suggests Fed chief 'shouldn’t step down right now’
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell need not resign. This statement comes after Bessent called for a review of the Fed's operations. Bessent believes Powell should complete his term, ending in May 2026. His comments follow pressure from President Donald Trump's administration to lower interest rates. Michelle Bowman defended the Fed's independence.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Not too distant’: Trump hints at upcoming China visit; meeting with Xi on cards
item.description: President Trump hinted at a potential trip to China to meet with President Xi Jinping, possibly coinciding with the APEC summit or the 80th anniversary of the end of World War II. While trade negotiations and geopolitical tensions persist, Trump expressed optimism about the US-China relationship, even as the US presses China on trade and regional security.

item.title: Who is Connor Estelle? Man loses job after 'I'm a fascist' remark; raises $20K in donations
item.description: Connor Estelle, who identified himself as a fascist during a debate, claims he was fired for his “traditional right-wing views.” Estelle, known as Pinesap online, appeared on Jubilee's Surrounded, defending autocracy and dismissing concerns about being labeled a Nazi. He has launched a GiveSendGo fundraiser, which has already raised over $20,000, with some donations containing white supremacist codes.

item.title: San Francisco to ban RV living; Mayor cites trash, safety issues; hundreds face displacement
item.description: San Francisco is on the verge of banning RV living on city streets, potentially displacing hundreds of unhoused residents. Mayor Daniel Lurie's initiative aims to clean up the city with strict parking rules, limiting RVs to two-hour stays. While the city offers limited housing assistance, critics argue it's insufficient, especially after closing the city-run RV lot.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Justice department to question Ghislaine Maxwell; lawyer says 'she’ll testify truthfully'
item.description: The US Justice Department plans to question Ghislaine Maxwell amid growing political pressure on the Trump administration regarding the Epstein case. Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche stated that President Trump ordered the release of all credible evidence. Maxwell's lawyer confirmed ongoing discussions with the government, emphasising her commitment to truthful testimony.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UK billionaire declares ‘Britain has gone to hell,’ lists $337m London estate on sale and moves to Dubai
item.description: Billionaire shipping magnate John Fredriksen has left the UK for the UAE, citing unfavourable tax reforms and economic decline. Following the abolition of Britain’s non-dom status, he’s selling his £250 million Chelsea mansion and relocating his business empire to Dubai. His move highlights a growing exodus of wealth from Britain to more tax-friendly hubs like the UAE.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Dubai’s Nol card explained: What it is, how it works, and why every visitor must have one
item.description: Dubai’s Nol card is a smart, rechargeable pass that makes public transport simple and cash-free. Ideal for tourists, the Silver Nol card works across the Metro, buses, trams, and more. It’s easy to use, cost-effective, and even works for parking and retail purchases. With just one tap, exploring Dubai becomes hassle-free and budget-friendly.

Dog the Bounty Hunter’s stepson under psychiatric care after accidentally killing teenage son
item.description: Gregory Zecca, stepson of Duane 'Dog the Bounty Hunter' Chapman, is under psychiatric observation after the accidental shooting death of his 13-year-old son, Anthony, in Florida. Authorities have placed Zecca under medical supervision due to concerns about his wellbeing following the tragic incident. The family is requesting prayers as they cope with the devastating loss, while the police investigation continues.

item.title: Minnesota senator Mitchell to resign after burglary conviction; Democrats risk losing majority
item.description: Minnesota State Senator Nicole Mitchell, convicted of felony burglary, will resign by August 4th after completing legislative duties. Her conviction, stemming from breaking into her stepmother's home, intensifies political tensions in the narrowly divided Senate. Republicans criticize the delay, while Democrats expect her to honor her pledge to resign if convicted, setting the stage for a special election.
